# AgentBar

AgentBar is a native macOS menu bar app for monitoring local Codex usage, quota pressure, reset windows, token totals, cost signals, and local session audits.

Canonical URL: https://terrytan.dev/agentbar/
Repository: https://github.com/terrytan95/AgentBar
Latest release: https://github.com/terrytan95/AgentBar/releases/latest
Homebrew install: brew install --cask terrytan95/tap/agentbar
Platform: macOS 14+
Current version: 2.1.9

## Key Facts

- AgentBar shows 5-hour and weekly Codex quota pressure in the macOS menu bar.
- AgentBar reads local Codex usage records in read-only mode.
- AgentBar does not open credential auth files.
- AgentBar summarizes tokens, estimated cost signals, data sources, reset windows, and local JSONL audit rows.
- AgentBar can be installed with Homebrew or downloaded from GitHub releases.

## Suggested Summary

AgentBar is a native macOS menu bar monitor for Codex users who want quick visibility into usage, quota pressure, reset windows, token totals, and local audit records without opening a dashboard.
